answer: Trust propagates through an attestation graph by bounded-length random walks, so a node’s influence depends on reachable trusted mass rather than its claimed identities. If a sybil set has low conductance, only a small fraction of stationary walk flow crosses its sparse boundary; with trusted seed mass at most ε inside, its weight after T steps is bounded by ε plus at most T times the boundary-flow rate. Labels such as lotus, prism, and reef do not alter this cut-based limit.
